title: MorningRecommendationV0
description: V0 knife 2 output written to data/morning/YYYY-MM-DD.json. Image references are copied verbatim as {key, sha256} from the wardrobe index. reason tags are closed rule labels (weather, season, wear_count, status). Failures use the same path and carry error instead of an invented outfit. This file does not add wardrobe-v1 fields.

key.description: Object key copied from the index. Not a URL and not a thumbnail path.

sha256.description: SHA-256 copied from the index (Iris Fix digest of the original bytes). This knife does not recompute it.

text.description: One closed Chinese sentence. Category labels and ids only, so visual prose cannot pass.

cos_keys.description: Verbatim {key, sha256} copies for the selected items, then the matched outfit if outfit_id is set. Empty when those records have no objects. No hashless thumbnail and no URL.

items.pattern: ^(只选 status=active|需要上装和下装|有鞋则选一双|并列时取更低 wear_count|未提供季节，不过滤|季节：(spring|summer|autumn|winter)（(命令行|天气缓存)）|未提供天气|无天气，不因寒冷加外搭|气温：-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]{1,4})?°C|天气状况：[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}|冷天加外搭|冷天无可用外搭|非冷天，不选外搭|已选鞋|无可用鞋|事件文件不存在，已跳过|已忽略事件规则|事件规则无排除|事件排除：[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}|命中清单套装 [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}|未命中已有套装)$
